g.text: DETERMINISTIC SPINE: evidence supports learned structure. The work journal records intent before effects and results before output.
LEARNING THE BUSINESS

text.tspan: Claim admission (C-G3.2)
A person approves each semantic claim before it enters L0. Promotion evidence grows
with consequence. Governed live queries read current operational facts from their
owning systems.

g.text: Knowledge source of truth (L0)
RUNNING DURABLE WORK

text.tspan: Governed release (C-G4.8)
Every registered external answer is classified. The service consumes the required
verdicts and saves the release or refusal record before output.

g.text: The acting user, or a calling service

text.tspan: Legend. The dark band shows shared truth controls. The dark cylinder is L0. Green edges carry approved knowledge. Blue-grey marks the operational
plane. Sand marks governed control state. A red rule marks a control point. The repair strip follows dependency order and ends in a recorded result.
Derived contracts use observed
evidence. Maker-checker review
governs promotion. Evidence grows
with consequence.
Each assembled figure records
its source path and build stamp.
Intent persists before the effect;
the result persists before anyone
sees it.

and ends in a recorded success or
failure state.
Discover and prioritise the estate (C-G1.6)
Each system and store records its access path, sensitivity and materiality.
Materiality, connection cost and risk set the order. A source with a weak
interface receives a degraded-reach status.
Allocate every stream to one plane (C-G1.6)
The allowed values are knowledge ingest, operational federation and human capture.
Missing allocation fails configuration. Each connector declares its plane,
conformance evidence, scope label, deletion signal and tombstone signal.
Authored engineering contracts
People write and version these contracts. Governed control state stores them.
Derive organisational contracts (C-G2.6)
Source-boundary, data-product and service-model contracts share one lifecycle.
Evidence creates an observed draft. Maker-checker review promotes the contract
to of-record status. Each contract has a clear scope, independent evidence,
operation-level confirmation and live conformance checks. Its envelope references
one semantic identity admitted by C-G3.2.
Resolve the enterprise's entities (C-G3.4)
Rules resolve clear matches across sources and business unit scopes. Uncertain
matches wait for review. C-G3.1 supplies the field survivorship verdict.
Capture lineage as figures are assembled (C-G3.3)
Each record carries its source. Each materialised figure stores a build stamp and
a queryable source path. A federated answer stores its query-time lineage before
release. Release requires a valid path and matching stamp.
Consolidate insight and generate products (C-G2.5)
Live federation serves current facts. A declared projection carries a build stamp,
an independent reconciliation result, a source path and a freshness state. Recall
reads the knowledge plane. A source change marks the projection stale until rebuild
and reconciliation complete.
Frame the service model at enterprise scope (C-G2.6)
Independent evidence describes each service, its consumer and its operation.
The people who run the service confirm it at operation level.

g.text: SPINE CONTROL · claim admission

text.tspan: Durable agent work (C-X3)
A task-keyed journal stores nested intent and result units under a versioned session
definition. Intent is saved before an effect. The result is saved before output,
acknowledgement or offset advance. Recovery uses the effect class. It repeats pure
reads, retries safe writes and reconciles uncertain non-idempotent outcomes. Replay
resumes and audits recorded state.
Human oversight (C-G5.2)
This service owns the human verdict. The work journal stores the approval wait
and resumes work from the recorded verdict.
Journal summary
A generated reading view over the work journal. Replay reads the full journal.

g.text: Bounded repair, in dependency order

text.tspan: Human gate on irreversible recovery
A person approves each irreversible recovery step. The journal stores the wait
and the verdict across restarts.

g.text: SPINE CONTROL · registered release path
SPINE CONTROL · recorded human verdict

text.tspan: Detect silent failure (C-G6.2)
compare reported success with expected evidence
Degrade gracefully (C-G6.5)
serve the answer surfaces whose dependencies remain healthy
Recover from store (C-G6.3)
restore every surviving authoritative family: L0, governed control state,
workflow envelopes and permitted payloads, release and refusal records;
then rebuild the derived views from them
Observe the running system (C-G6.11)
health, dependency, environment, schedule and repair telemetry, correlated
to the workflow event that carried the work
Terminal repair state
The repair run records success or failure and ends.
